problems_encountered.problem: go.sh环境配置文件因heredoc在双层引号(ssh双引号+bash单引号)下$PATH被提前展开,导致PATH未包含/usr/local/go/bin;且dnf安装的swig4.1.1(/usr/bin/swig)在PATH中先于pip安装的swig4.3.1(/usr/local/bin/swig),覆盖mindio所需的>=4.2.0版本
problems_encountered.solution: 用引号包裹的heredoc(<<EOF)重写go.sh避免变量提前展开;mv /usr/bin/swig为.swig.dnf-4.1.1并ln -sf /usr/local/bin/swig /usr/bin/swig使4.3.1优先,swig -version确认为4.3.1

problems_encountered.problem: build_all.sh第1次失败:(1)clusterd build.sh设置CGO_ENABLED=0+-linkmode=external,go1.26严格模式报"linkmode=external requires external (cgo) linking";(2)ascend-for-volcano需要/usr/local/musl/bin/musl-gcc但未安装;(3)helm-deploy-tool阶段yq not found(因构建前rm -rf /go误删go install的yq/helm)
problems_encountered.solution: (1)回退GOTOOLCHAIN patch让clusterd用go1.21.13(go自动下载,1.21容忍CGO_ENABLED=0+linkmode=external);(2)dnf install musl-gcc + ln -sf /usr/bin/musl-gcc /usr/local/musl/bin/musl-gcc;(3)重装yq/helm/gotestsum并ln -sf到/usr/local/bin(默认PATH),不再在构建前rm -rf /go

problems_encountered.problem: clusterd test.sh依赖gocov/gocov-html生成覆盖率HTML,但gocov的旧版golang.org/x/tools(v0.13.0)与go1.26不兼容(tokeninternal.go: invalid array length -delta*delta编译错误),gocov-html模块路径也已变更无法直接go install
problems_encountered.solution: 改用build/README.md第5节文档化的直接go test方案: TZ=Asia/Shanghai GOFLAGS="-gcflags=all=-l -mod=mod" go test -count=1 ./pkg/...,绕过gocov覆盖率工具,聚焦用例通过率验证
